file_info.description: VFX & Special Features - Optional module for supernatural elements and specific color palettes

Styling: Vividly render [HAIR_COLOR] hair and clear, transparent [EYE_COLOR] pupils as seen in the [REFERENCE_IMG].
Halo VFX: If present in [REFERENCE_IMG], render the Halo as a luminous, high-quality CG energy ring. It should have a subtle ethereal glow (bloom effect) and cast realistic ambient light onto the subject's hair and shoulders.
Animal Features: If present in [REFERENCE_IMG], recreate animal ears and tails with highly realistic fur textures that seamlessly blend with the character's hair. They should look like natural biological features, not cheap props.
Wig Props: [WIG_PROP_ITEMS] 스타일의 날개 소품을 잊지 말고 추가하시오.
